Subject: MAP v3 + proposed sign-by window and start slot

Hi Sara / Helix team,

Attached is the updated mutual action plan (Helix_MAP_v3.pdf) with the items we committed to during last week's evaluation session. Key ask: can we lock a sign-by date of July 22 so we can reserve the Dedicated capacity pool for your onboarding week starting Aug 2?

Highlights:
- Deployment scope locked (3 models, private VPC)
- Measured latency targets and baseline load test passed (report in MAP)
- Requested lead time for infra prep: 10 business days after signature

Please confirm:
1) Your procurement team is comfortable with the payment milestone (50% on signature, 50% on go-live)
2) Legal redlines (if any) are returned by EOD July 16 so we can turn around before the July 22 window

I can prepare the DocuSign lane once we confirm signers and exact start date.

Attachments: Helix_MAP_v3.pdf (see section 4: rollouts + fallback policy)

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

—
Markus Klein

markus.klein@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP v3 + proposed sign-by window and start slot

Hi Markus — thanks for the MAP and clear asks. Procurement has a couple of standard checks they need to run; our counsel has one technical redline around data retention wording.

We can target signature on or before July 22, contingent on a short legal review (we'll return comments by July 16). Tentative go-live: Aug 2 as you suggested — that start date works for our ops calendar.

Action items on our side:
- Procurement to confirm billing entity and send PO template by Wed (Jul 14)
- Legal to mark up retention clause and share redline by Fri (Jul 16)

Also please include a clear ribbon for who signs (procurement vs. authorized officer) — we typically need procurement + VP Ops signatures.

Thanks,
Sara Lopez
Head of Digital Products | HelixHealth
(206) 555-2299

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 08:30:00 -0400
Subject: RE: MAP v3 + proposed sign-by window and start slot

Markus — quick internal note. I skimmed the Helix call notes and the retention redline looks standard (customer data retention and export rights). I pulled together a brief summary of what we'd accept vs what needs legal sign-off. See attached: redlines_summary.docx.

Proposed internal approach:
- Offer a 30-day export window (no change to default archival policy) — this should satisfy them and keeps our footprint predictable.
- If legal insists on a longer retention clause, we require a compliance review and an additional fee for extended storage.

I'll loop in Lauren to finalize the language and prepare a sign-lane (procurement -> VP Ops). If Lauren gives the green light today we can spin up a DocuSign envelope and push to Sara.

—Grace
Sr. Manager, Customer Success Operations | Redwood Inference

- Invoice 1 (50%): Issued on signature, payment due net 30
- Invoice 2 (50%): Issued on go-live, payment due net 30

Hi Sara / Helix team — thanks for the redline. We have reviewed and are prepared to accept the retention language as edited in redlines_summary.docx, with the export window set to 30 days. No changes to liability or indemnity were requested, so we will leave standard terms in place.

Next steps:
1) Jordan to send the finalized pricing and create DocuSign envelope with two signature roles: Procurement (PO) + VP Ops (contract)
2) Helix to confirm PO number and signers by EOD July 21
3) Upon signature we will issue Invoice 1 and schedule infra prep for start date Aug 2 (10 business days prep)

DocuSign envelope (internal reference): ENVELOPE-8492 — Jordan, please create and CC DocuSign notifications to both parties.
